title: Design a File Sharing System
summary: Design a chunk-sharing system: join assigns the smallest free positive user id; leave frees a user id; request returns the sorted owners of a chunk and, if at least one owner exists, makes the requester an owner too.
inputFormat: join takes a list of owned chunk ids; leave takes a user id; request takes a user id and a chunk id.
outputFormat: join returns the assigned user id; leave returns nothing; request returns a sorted list of user ids.
tieRules: Smallest available positive user id is assigned on join; owners are returned sorted.
edgeRules: If there are no owners, ownership does not change (draft).

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.note: Conditional: assumes the returned list is taken before the requester gains ownership.

factsMissing: Whether the returned list is captured before or after the requester is added
questions: Is the owner list returned by request taken before the requester is added, and does it include the requester when already an owner?
